objective: Continue the semantic thread using the recent anchored context instead of restarting from scratch.
stable_instructions: Assume the author is continuing the previous editorial thread.
Reuse recent context when it is still safe and supported.
Answer with the next useful move, not with a recap of the system state.
prudence_rules: If the follow-up is too underspecified, do not pretend certainty.
Do not force the author to repeat the target when continuity is already strong enough.
Only ask for clarification if continuity is materially unsafe.
author_style: Then move straight into the useful next suggestion.
output_expectations: Return a concise contextual continuation that feels like a real editorial conversation.
insufficient_support_behavior: If continuity is not safe, say what thread still seems likely and what minimum clarification would focus it.
